purpose.domain_detail: Expense report processing - reads CSV expense reports for a location called CASABLANCA and writes sorted output
purpose.summary: Reads expense records from a CSV file (CASABLANCA.csv) and writes them to a sorted output CSV file. The program opens input and output files, reads records in a loop, and writes each record to the output file. A sort file (SD) is defined but the SORT verb is not actually used.

notable_features: SD sort file descriptor defined but SORT verb not invoked
LINE SEQUENTIAL organization for CSV files
PERFORM UNTIL loop with EOF flag
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields
Incomplete sort implementation - SD defined without SORT verb
verdict.notes: The program defines an SD (sort description) file TP but never uses a SORT verb, suggesting incomplete or abandoned sort logic. The WRITE with AFTER ADVANCING on a LINE SEQUENTIAL file may cause issues depending on compiler. The record layout for IN-REC appears to be a flat fixed-length record rather than CSV-delimited, which may not correctly parse CSV input. Overall appears to be a student exercise or early-stage development.
